@: Make clip: a trimmed copy of a moment saved to the clip folder (web/js/makeclip.js).
pick_first: Pick an event or play a recording first.
already: This clip is already being made.
making_exact: Making the clip, frame-exact. This takes a little longer because the picture is re-encoded.
making_copy: Making the clip. It will start on the nearest keyframe before your in point.
saved_early:
Clip saved: {name}
It starts {seconds} before your in point (nearest keyframe).
@saved_early: The seconds value is an already formatted duration, such as 1.2 sec.
check_mismatch: The clip does not fully match the recording. Check it before you use it.
failed: The clip could not be made: {error}
